title: W-C click=focus hooks not fired on the right-click pipe-select and pad Node_Select paths — same-object re-select after a banner nav does not re-home there
evidence:
exec.odin:619-623 (right_click_select):
	if pid, ok := pipe_hit(inp.topo, inp.cat, wx, wy); ok {
		inp.sel_pipe = i64(pid)
		inp.sel_node = -1
		inp.sel_class = 0
		inp.qos_editing = false // a fresh selection starts with the editor closed

exec.odin:199-203 (Node_Select mirror):
		if inp.pad_has {
			slot, ok := pp.node_slot(inp.topo, inp.pad_node)
			if ok && slot < u32(len(inp.topo.node_kind)) && inp.topo.node_kind[slot] == .Junction {
				inp.sel_node = i64(inp.pad_node)
				inp.sel_pipe = -1

Contrast — click_select fires the hook (exec.odin:415-418):
		if inp.topo.node_kind[slot] == .Junction {
			inp.sel_node = i64(id)
			inp.sel_pipe = -1
			if inp.on_node_selected != nil { inp.on_node_selected(inp.user, inp) } // 7.1: click = focus
detail: The fold fires the re-home hooks only in click_select (mouse/touch). right_click_select and the pad Node_Select mirror set selection without hooks, so re-selecting the already-selected pipe/junction after a banner nav leaves the camera diverged (no selection change → no diff, no hook); the 're-targets on the next click' comments overclaim.
recommended_fix: Fire on_pipe_selected in right_click_select's pipe branch and on_node_selected in the Node_Select junction mirror (or document those paths as deliberate exceptions in the W-C divergence notes at main.odin:688/1178).
